about: This is the 10th annual Christmas on the Square, according to the City of Newberry event listing. The setting is CountryWay Town Square, a shopping and dining center at 1739 SW 248th Dr. Suite 20 in Newberry.

The evening is built around a live nativity, live music and stage performances, with food and shopping on site. Because the host page does not print a price, plan on checking with the city before you go if cost matters.
Families heading out that night should know that the city also lists its Christmas parade on December 19 at 6 PM, at a different site. They are two separate events with their own locations.

CountryWay Town Square sits on SW 248th Drive in Newberry, a small city west of Gainesville. The city's listing gives that address and a 6 PM start, and it labels the event a festive evening for the whole community.
The city page gives no entry price, no parking details and no end time, so those are left unstated here. The three-hour window on this page is a planning estimate from the 6 PM start.

The program as the city describes it has five parts: live music, performances, food, shopping and a live nativity. Families with young children can pick the nativity and the music, and the shopping and food give adults something to do while the kids watch.
faq: Is there a live nativity?
Yes. The City of Newberry listing names a live nativity along with live music, performances, food and shopping.
Where is it held?
At CountryWay Town Square, 1739 SW 248th Dr. Suite 20, Newberry, FL 32669.
Is it the same night as the Newberry Christmas Parade?
Both are listed for Saturday, December 19, 2026 at 6 PM, at different locations, so choose one to start with.
What is the address?
1739 SW 248th Dr. Suite 20, Newberry, FL 32669, as printed in the city listing.
Does the listing give a ticket price?
No. The City of Newberry page does not print a price, so confirm with the city if you need one.
Which year is this event?
The listing is for Saturday, December 19, 2026 and says it is the 10th annual.
What can kids do there?
The city lists performances, live music and a live nativity, which suit families, along with food and shopping.
Who hosts it?
The City of Newberry lists it on its official calendar.

about: The parade is organized by the Newberry Main Street Organization and listed on the City of Newberry calendar as the NMSO Christmas Parade, with Newberry High School shown as the location at 400 SW 258th St.

Groups that want to ride or walk in the parade register their float through an online form. The listing says there is no registration fee and warns that organizers will not ask anyone for payment to take part.
The city notes that parade email messages come from a single organizer address, which helps float entries avoid scam messages. Watching the parade requires no registration.

The city listing includes a parade flyer image and a link to a Facebook event page run by the organizers. The Facebook page is where the group posts updates, while the city calendar is the official date and time source used here.
Newberry High School is on SW 258th Street. The listing names the school as the location, and it does not publish a route map, so check the flyer or the organizers for the lineup and route.

Parade entries are free, and the city page lists a Jotform registration link for floats. The organizers say they want floats registered ahead so they can plan the lineup and put on the best parade yet.
Spectators do not register. Anyone coming to watch can simply arrive for the 6 PM start on Saturday, December 19.

Scam awareness is part of the listing itself. Organizers say all parade email comes from one named Gmail address and that nobody will be asked to pay to join, which is useful for school, scout and church groups lining up a float.
faq: Do floats have to pay to enter?
No. The city listing says there is no registration fee and that organizers will not ask for payment.
How do I enter a float?
Use the registration form linked from the City of Newberry event page.
What time does it start?
The city calendar lists 6:00 PM on Saturday, December 19, 2026.
Is the parade free to watch?
Public parades are free to attend, and the city listing asks for no payment from participants.
Where is the listing location?
Newberry High School, 400 SW 258th St, Newberry, FL 32669.
Who runs the parade?
The listing is titled NMSO Christmas Parade, from the Newberry Main Street Organization.
Do spectators need to register?
No. Registration on the listing is for float entries only.
Is there a rain plan?
The city listing does not state one, so check the organizers' Facebook event page.
Can a school or scout group join?
The listing invites anyone to register a float through the online form and charges no fee.

about: The park is the old Florida homestead where Marjorie Kinnan Rawlings lived and wrote in the 1930s, and the holiday event uses that setting. Florida State Parks says the house is decorated in typical 1930s fashion for the tour.

Regular park fees apply: the park charges $3 per vehicle, and the event is free with that admission. The park's farmyard and trails are normally open daily from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., while the event runs later, from 5 PM to 7:30 PM.

Picnic facilities, a boat ramp to Orange Lake and a playground are in the adjacent county park, according to the park page. For questions, the park lists 352-466-3672 and the email mkrhousetours@floridadep.gov.

The farmhouse interior is usually seen on a guided tour, which the park schedules Thursday through Sunday at set hours. Guided tours carry no fee, and donations are gratefully accepted according to the park.
Other nearby park dates listed on the same page include a wood stove cooking event on December 11 from 10:30 am to 1 pm and a First Day Hike on January 1, 2027 at 9:30 am.
faq: What does the event include?
The firing of the grove, festive music and a tour of the main part of the house decorated in 1930s fashion.
How much does it cost?
The event is free with park admission of $3 per vehicle.
How do I contact the park?
Call 352-466-3672 or email mkrhousetours@floridadep.gov.
Is the farmhouse open for the event?
The listing says guests can tour the main part of the house decorated for the holidays.
Where is the park?
18700 S County Road 325, Cross Creek, FL 32640.
Are there other December programs?
Yes, the park lists a wood stove cooking event on December 11, 2026.
